_i=0
while [ $_i -lt $_max ]; do
  _log=$(cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/cursor-impl.log" 2>/dev/null || true)
  # Check if manifest file appeared (indicates completion)
  if [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/manifest.json" ] && [ -s "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/manifest.json" ]; then
    echo "MANIFEST_READY=true"

    break

  # Check PID still alive
  if ! kill -0 57742 2>/dev/null; then
